architecture.text: Researchers are tackling long-context attention limits, vector-quantized tokenization stability, and 3D-consistent world generation using recurrent attention, hyperbolic geometry, and two-level KV sharing.

new-models.text: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MintAct lead recent releases, while flow-based generative models, foundation model embeddings, and mixture-of-experts frameworks dominate material discovery, medical prediction, and physical security.

inference-methods.text: Practitioners are deploying on-policy distillation, Disaggregated Quantization, CompKV, and just-in-time state management to scale 200K-token contexts, sub-3-bit reasoning, and hardware-constrained inference.

inference-engines.text: Engineers are optimizing large language model and agentic serving using vLLM prefix caching, HBM flash memory tiering, and NVIDIA Topograph topology-aware scheduling to reduce latency.

silicon.text: Engineers are scaling AI hardware by optimizing TPUs like v6e, managing GPU cluster power surges, and integrating HBM, optical interconnects, and low-cost FPGAs.

training.text: Practitioners are tackling reward hacking and credit assignment across RL and diffusion pipelines using rubric rewards, group relative policy optimization, and agentic reinforcement learning.

economics.text: Inference costs are collapsing industry-wide by 40 to 50 percent, driving a macroeconomic shift toward tokens too cheap to meter and forcing a re-evaluation of self-hosted open-weight unit economics.
